## What's new

- **Automatic updates.** KeepShot now checks GitHub Releases for signed updates shortly after launch and every 6 hours. When a new version is available it shows up in the tray menu and in **Settings › Updates**, and installs with one click.
- **Error log.** Errors are written to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dev.keepshot.app\logs\keepshot.log` to make bug reports easier.

## Upgrading from 0.1.0

0.1.0 shipped without the updater, so install this version manually once (run the installer over the existing one — settings and history are kept). Future versions will update automatically.

> The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.
